source: Run107 15 valid target windows; borrowed vllm_ascend/attention/dsa_v1.py decode source

source_mapping.c4: two distinct compressor calls: attention compressed-KV state and indexer compressed-KV state, then lightning indexer and sparse attention
source_mapping.c128: one attention compressed-KV compressor then sparse attention; no lightning indexer
source_mapping.transpose: appears after sparse attention and HCCL alltoall in trace; not part of pre-attention DSA chain

decision: The 62 Compressor invocations are exactly 21 c4*2 +20 c128*1 and correspond to distinct mandatory state/cache products, not duplicate recomputation. Indexer topk feeds c4 sparse attention. Trace/source do not expose a semantics-preserving redundant intermediate or source-level >=5ms fusion. Do not sum mandatory DSA stages as removable gain.
script_attempts: Initial local script asserted CompressorMetadata count equals Compressor count; failed because metadata kernels are sometimes absent even when compressor operations remain. Corrected assertion to classify by Compressor+Indexer only; final 15-window result passed. No serving or NPU work.
